title.en: Gao Shi at the county desk

summary.en:
A county job brought Gao Shi close to the machinery of Tang government. Appointed to Fengqiu in 749, he described an office where even a small jurisdiction generated deadlines, formal greetings and punishments. His poem “Written at Fengqiu” turns from the humiliation of bowing before superiors to the distress of flogging ordinary people. At home, the speaker’s family laughs at the life he has acquired. The scene gives local administration a voice quite different from a court proclamation.

Gao left the post in 752 and later served on a frontier staff. Reading this episode beside Du Fu and Bai Juyi connects poetic ambition with the daily work of government. The poem offers a crafted account of an official’s discomfort; its force comes from bringing hierarchy, household conversation and the people subject to punishment into the same frame.
summary.zh:
749年，高适出任封丘县尉，进入唐代地方行政的日常。《封丘作》写小县也有繁多期限，要迎送上官，还要执行刑罚。诗人从向上司屈身的难堪，写到鞭打百姓的悲伤；回家诉说，家人却笑他如今的处境。县衙的权力关系、普通人的遭遇和家庭里的对话，就这样进入同一首诗。

高适于752年离职，后来进入边地幕府。把这段经历与杜甫、白居易的作品并读，可以看到文学志向怎样与治理事务相遇。诗中的官员带有作者经营的自我形象，并非县务档案；它仍让读者贴近地方官在等级、职责与同情之间感到的冲突。

dateNote.en: 749–752 marks the inspected chronology of the Fengqiu appointment and resignation. The poem is associated with the posting; no exact composition day is asserted.
dateNote.zh: 749—752年对应所核查的封丘任职与辞官时段。诗与这段任职经历相关，不指定确切写作日期。

sources.title: 高适
sources.evidenceNote: Biography dates the appointment to 749, departure to Tianbao 11 (752), and subsequent frontier service. Used for career context, not its evaluative ranking of poets.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 传记记749年任封丘县尉、天宝十一载（752）辞官及后来入幕经历。采用仕历，不采用诗人高下评价。

sources.title: 封丘作
sources.publisher: 高适；维基文库古典文本
sources.evidenceNote: The inspected poem describes deadlines, greeting superiors, flogging commoners and conversation with the speaker’s family. Original paraphrase of a public-domain poem; no modern translation copied.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 所读诗文写公务期限、迎送上官、鞭挞黎庶与归家问妻子。依据公版古诗自行转述，未复制现代译文。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis from inspected institutional, primary-text and scholarly passages; each source states which claims it supports.

reviewLimit.en: Poetic self-presentation is distinguished from administrative documentation; the source does not establish the frequency of punishments or the responses of the people punished.
reviewLimit.zh: 区分诗人的自我叙述与行政档案；作品不能确定刑罚的频率，也未记录受罚者的回应。

title.en: A royal tomb with names: Muryeong and his queen
title.zh: 有名可考的王陵：武宁王与王后

labelI18n.zh: 公州宋山里古坟群一带

summary.en:
Two stone inscriptions changed what a royal burial could tell historians. King Muryeong of Baekje died in 523 and was buried in 525; his queen was buried in the same tomb in 529. The epitaphs identify the occupants, allowing objects to be connected with named people and a sequence of funerals. A land-purchase text even made the burial place part of a written transaction.

The chamber and its contents open a wider map. Brick construction recalls tombs of China’s Southern Dynasties, Chinese ceramics accompanied the royal pair, and the wooden coffins used timber from Japan. These were choices made for an elite burial, bringing different materials and practices together. Excavation in 1971 recovered the assemblage in haste; later analysis has revisited the placement of objects. The tomb therefore reveals both sixth-century connections and how archaeological knowledge is revised.
summary.zh:
两块石质墓志，使一座王陵能够与具体姓名和葬仪次序相连。百济武宁王于523年去世、525年下葬，王后于529年葬入同一墓室。墓志确定了墓主身份，买地券则以书面交易的形式安排死者的安息之地。

墓室与随葬品还展开了一幅更广的联系图：砖室形制与中国南朝墓葬相近，王室使用了中国陶瓷，木棺所用木材来自日本。这些材料和做法汇集于精英葬仪，体现王室对不同资源的选择。1971年的发掘十分仓促，后来研究又重新讨论器物的摆放位置。王陵既保存六世纪的跨海联系，也让人看到考古知识如何随着资料重读而改变。

dateNote.en: The selected interval runs from Muryeong’s death in 523 to the queen’s burial in 529. The king’s burial was in 525. These are different events, not competing dates for one funeral.
dateNote.zh: 所选时段从523年武宁王去世至529年王后下葬；王于525年下葬。各年对应不同事件，并非同一场葬礼的异说。

sources.title: Gold Diadem Ornaments Unearthed from the Tomb of King Muryeong
sources.evidenceNote: The Muryeong section identifies the royal occupants through epitaphs and describes Chinese ceramics, a land-purchase certificate and coffins made with Japanese wood.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 武宁王部分说明墓志确认墓主身份，并介绍中国陶瓷、买地券及使用日本木材的棺木。

sources.title: Reconstructing the Funerary Process within the Burial Chamber of the Tomb of King Muryeong
sources.publisher: Kang Wonpyo, Journal of Korean Art and Archaeology 19 (2025), National Museum of Korea; OAK repository
sources.evidenceNote: Inspected Introduction and Reconstructing the Funerary Process sections: 523 death, 525 burial, queen’s 529 burial, rushed 1971 excavation and later reassessment. Hypothetical movements of individual objects are not asserted as fact.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 核查导言与葬仪复原章节：王卒于523年、葬于525年，王后529年下葬，1971年仓促发掘及后来重检。未将个别器物移动的复原假说写成事实。

sources.title: Baekje Historic Areas
sources.evidenceNote: The statement of Outstanding Universal Value situates Gongju’s royal tombs within Baekje’s exchanges with China and Japan.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 突出普遍价值说明将公州王陵置于百济与中国、日本的交流之中。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis from inspected institutional, primary-text and scholarly passages; each source states which claims it supports.

reviewLimit.en: The precise order of moving ritual objects remains a research reconstruction. Royal grave goods do not describe the possessions of every Baekje household.
reviewLimit.zh: 仪式物品移动的具体次序仍属研究复原；王室随葬品不能代表所有百济家庭的财物。

title.en: Iron plates, skilled hands: armor in Gaya
title.zh: 铁片与匠手：伽倻的甲胄

summary.en:
Armor from Tomb 32 at Jisan-dong turns a burial mound into evidence of skilled work. Its makers joined iron plates with rivets and produced separate protection for the torso, neck and shoulders. The surviving pieces preserve decisions about shape and assembly, even though the craftspeople’s names have disappeared. The National Museum of Korea places Daegaya’s production of this armor type in the fifth century and connects the tradition with earlier work in Geumgwan Gaya.

The surrounding cemeteries also change the political picture. Gaya comprised several centers whose tombs share practices while differing in scale and layout. UNESCO interprets them as evidence of a network of autonomous polities. Ironwork thus connects military equipment with workshops, elite display and relationships between neighboring communities. An impressive suit of armor can show technical expertise without establishing that one ruler controlled the whole region.
summary.zh:
池山洞32号墓出土的甲胄，把墓丘与工匠的工作联系起来。制作者以铆钉连接铁片，并分别制作护身、护颈、护肩部件。工匠姓名没有留下，器物却保存了对形状和组装方式的选择。韩国国立中央博物馆把大伽倻此类甲胄的生产置于五世纪，并联系到更早的金官伽倻制作传统。

周围的墓地也有助于理解政治结构。伽倻包含多个中心，各地墓葬既有共同做法，规模和布局又不相同。联合国教科文组织将这些遗存解释为自主政治体之间的联系。由此，铁器不仅关联战争，还关联工坊、精英身份展示和邻近社群的往来；一套精良甲胄能够展示技术，却不足以证明某位君主统治整个地区。

dateNote.en: 400–500 is an approximate fifth-century display interval for the armor-production phase described by the museum, not a precise date for the occupant of Tomb 32.
dateNote.zh: 400—500年是博物馆所述五世纪甲胄生产阶段的约略展示范围，并非32号墓墓主的确切年代。

sources.title: Armor from Jisan-dong Tomb 32
sources.evidenceNote: The armor section describes nailed iron plates, separate neck and shoulder protection, the Goryeong findspot and fifth-century Daegaya manufacture.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 甲胄部分说明铆接铁片、护颈与护肩部件、高灵出土地以及大伽倻五世纪的制作。

sources.title: Gaya Tumuli
sources.evidenceNote: The Outstanding Universal Value statement interprets seven cemeteries as evidence of autonomous Gaya polities with shared cultural practices and varying hierarchies.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 突出普遍价值说明将七处墓地解释为伽倻自主政治体的证据：文化做法相通，等级与组织形式存在差别。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis from inspected institutional, primary-text and scholarly passages; each source states which claims it supports.

reviewLimit.en: Political organization is an archaeological interpretation of cemeteries. The story does not identify an individual smith, wearer or battle.
reviewLimit.zh: 政治结构来自对墓地的考古解释；本条不指定工匠、穿戴者或战役。

title.en: A gift inventory becomes a world of objects
title.zh: 一份献物清单里的器物世界

summary.en:
After Emperor Shōmu died in 756, Empress Kōmyō offered hundreds of his possessions to the Great Buddha at Tōdaiji. An inventory accompanied the gift. Instruments, games, clothing and medicines give the donation an intimacy that a reign list cannot: a ruler’s things became religious offerings and objects entrusted to a storehouse.

The Shōsōin holdings also preserve textiles associated with the Great Buddha’s eye-opening ceremony in 752 and commemorations in 757. Making and caring for them required more than a court: weaving, woodworking, music and record keeping all enter the story. Some objects arrived from Tang China, while other designs refer to traditions farther west. A Persian-looking vessel need not have been made in Persia. Reading an inventory alongside the objects helps distinguish a remembered owner, a donation date, a manufacturing place and the later work of preservation.
summary.zh:
圣武天皇于756年去世后，光明皇后把他的数百件遗物献给东大寺大佛，并附上献物清单。乐器、游戏用具、衣物和药品，使这次献纳带有生活的温度：君主使用过的东西，成为宗教供物，也成为交由库房保管的器物。

正仓院还保存与752年大佛开眼会、757年纪念法会有关的织物。制作和保存这些物件，需要织造、木工、音乐、文书等多种工作。有些器物来自唐朝，另一些纹样与更西方的传统相通；外形带有波斯风格，并不等于一定产自波斯。把清单与实物并读，就能分辨曾经的主人、献纳年代、制作地点以及后世保护工作的不同层次。

dateNote.en: 752–757 covers the ceremonies and donations discussed here. The principal donation was in 756; it is not the manufacture date of every object. Traditional lunar-calendar day numbers are not converted into unverified Gregorian dates.
dateNote.zh: 752—757年涵盖本条讨论的法会与献纳，主要献纳发生于756年；这不是每件器物的制作年。不将传统历法月日未经核查地换成公历日期。

sources.title: The Shosoin Treasure House
sources.evidenceNote: Describes Kōmyō’s 756 donation after Shōmu’s death, its inventory, the range of stored objects and the preservation setting.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 介绍圣武去世后光明皇后于756年的献纳、清单、器物种类与保存环境。

sources.title: Treasures of Shosoin
sources.evidenceNote: Exhibition passages associate textiles with the 752 and 757 ceremonies and discuss instruments and vessels with cross-regional styles, including uncertain places of manufacture.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 展览文字将织物与752年、757年法会相连，并讨论具有跨地区风格的乐器、器皿，包括制作地点存在不确定性的案例。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis from inspected institutional, primary-text and scholarly passages; each source states which claims it supports.

reviewLimit.en: Style, place of manufacture and route of transmission are separate questions. No complete itinerary is assigned to an object from its appearance.
reviewLimit.zh: 风格、产地与传播路径是不同问题；不根据外观为器物编排完整旅程。

location.label: Shuri and Naha, representative Ryūkyū court and port

labelI18n.en: Shuri and Naha, representative Ryūkyū court and port
labelI18n.zh: 首里与那霸，代表性琉球王府及港口

summary.en:
A ship needed documents as well as a hull. The Rekidai Hōan preserves copies of Ryūkyū’s diplomatic correspondence and trade papers from 1424 to 1867. Permits and accompanying documents could identify vessels, passengers and cargo, while letters placed exchanges within relationships between rulers. Much of this work passed through the literate community associated with Kumemura, whose history linked the kingdom with Fujian.

A major compilation in 1697 gathered papers generated over earlier centuries. The collection therefore lets readers see communication as sustained administrative labor: writing, copying, classifying and preserving. Its own survival depended on additional copies and transcripts after losses in the twentieth century. The papers make Ryūkyū visible as an active court managing overseas relationships. They also show why an archive’s date of compilation is different from the dates of the transactions it contains.
summary.zh:
船只出海，需要船身，也需要文书。《历代宝案》保存琉球1424—1867年的外交往来与贸易文书抄件。执照及随附文件可以注明船舶、乘员和货物，书信则把交换置于君主之间的关系中。许多文书工作由久米村的文人群体承担，其历史与福建相连。

1697年的一次集中编纂，将更早产生的文书汇集成册。读这些材料，可以看见持续的行政劳动：书写、抄录、分类与保存。二十世纪原有文本遭损失后，其他抄本和传录又成为保存内容的关键。文书中的琉球王府主动经营海外关系；这部档案也提醒读者，编纂年代与其中各次往来发生的年代并不相同。

dateNote.en: 1424–1867 is the span of the documents, not the kingdom’s full history. A documented compilation took place in 1697. Later twentieth-century losses belong to the archive’s transmission history.
dateNote.zh: 1424—1867年为所收文书的时段，并非琉球王国全部历史；1697年有一次确切记载的编纂。二十世纪的损失属于档案传承史。

sources.title: The Rekidai Hōan Documents of the Ryūkyū Kingdom
sources.publisher: Kyoto Review of Southeast Asia; translated Okinawa archival editorial
sources.evidenceNote: Body text supplies 1424–1867 contents, two-copy transmission and losses in 1923 and 1945. Its inconsistent opening year and erroneous ruler/annexation dates are excluded.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 正文说明文书范围1424—1867年、两套传本及1923年和1945年的损失。未采用开头不一致的起年及有误的君主、吞并年代。

sources.title: 歷代寶案（琉球之外交文書）
sources.publisher: National Taiwan University Library, translation of Kobata Atsushi’s 1992 study
sources.evidenceNote: Inspected discussion supports 1697 compilation, court and Kume copies, Kumemura’s literate community and the information carried in fuwen and zhizhao documents. An unrelated era-year conversion error is not reused.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 核查文字支持1697年编纂、王府与久米传本、久米村文人群体，以及符文、执照所载信息。未采用旁及年代中的年号换算错误。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis from inspected institutional, primary-text and scholarly passages; each source states which claims it supports.

reviewLimit.en: Surviving copies preserve selected official transactions, not every voyage or the voices of all sailors. Compilation, document and copy dates are kept separate.
reviewLimit.zh: 传本保存部分官方往来，并非所有航次或全体水手的声音；编纂、文书和抄本的年代分别处理。

title.en: Elm fiber and the hands that made an Ainu robe
title.zh: 榆树纤维与制作阿伊努长衣的双手

location.label: Hokkaido, representative region; this robe’s workshop is unrecorded

labelI18n.en: Hokkaido, representative region; this robe’s workshop is unrecorded
labelI18n.zh: 北海道，代表性地区；此衣制作地点未详

summary.en:
An Ainu robe in the Metropolitan Museum is made from elm fiber, with applied cloth and embroidery shaping its surface. The nineteenth-century garment brings work into view: obtaining bark, preparing thread, weaving, cutting and stitching. The museum describes women’s central roles in designing and making such robes. The object’s individual maker is unrecorded, but that absence need not make the labor invisible.

Clothing also belonged to a changing landscape. The Ainu Association describes the colonial administration established in Hokkaido in 1869 and the subsequent taking of Ainu land. The robe preserves material knowledge carried through those changes. Reading it beside Chiri Yukie’s later work with oral tradition connects different forms of cultural expression while keeping cloth, language and their makers’ histories distinct.
summary.zh:
大都会艺术博物馆收藏的一件阿伊努长衣，以榆树纤维织成，再用贴布与刺绣组织表面纹样。这件十九世纪衣物让多道劳动进入视野：取得树皮、制线、织布、裁剪、缝制。馆方介绍女性在设计和制作此类衣物中的重要作用。具体制作者的姓名没有记录，劳动本身却仍能从材料和针脚中读出。

衣物也属于不断变化的社会环境。北海道阿伊努协会记述了1869年北海道殖民行政机构的设立，以及此后阿伊努土地被夺取的过程。长衣保存了穿越这些变化的材料知识。把它与知里幸惠后来整理口述传统的工作并读，可以联系不同的文化表达，同时保留织物、语言及其传承者各自的历史。

dateNote.en: 1800–1900 is an approximate display interval for the museum’s nineteenth-century dating. The 1869 reference concerns colonial administration, not the date the robe was sewn.
dateNote.zh: 1800—1900年为馆方“十九世纪”断代的约略展示范围；1869年指殖民行政机构的设立，不是长衣的缝制年代。

sources.title: Ainu robe, 1999.247.1
sources.evidenceNote: Dates the robe to the nineteenth century, identifies elm fiber and embroidery, and describes women’s roles in design, weaving and sewing.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 将长衣断为十九世纪，注明榆树纤维、刺绣，并介绍女性在设计、织造、缝制中的作用。

sources.title: Ainu history
sources.evidenceNote: The inspected nineteenth-century section describes the 1869 Colonization Commission and 1872 expropriation of Ainu land. Other inconsistent dates and outdated present-day legal statements on the site are not used.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 核查十九世纪部分所述1869年开拓使及1872年阿伊努土地被夺取。未采用该站其他不一致的年代或过时的当代法律表述。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis from inspected institutional, primary-text and scholarly passages; each source states which claims it supports.

reviewLimit.en: The mapped region is representative; the maker and exact workshop are unknown. This historical garment does not imply that Ainu culture ended in 1900.
reviewLimit.zh: 地图标示代表性地区，制作者与具体工坊未知；历史衣物的时间范围不表示阿伊努文化在1900年终结。

title.en: Names on the stone: the donors of Sanchi
title.zh: 刻在石上的姓名：桑奇的施主

labelI18n.zh: 桑奇，代表性佛教遗址群

summary.en:
Dhamarakhitā of Madhuvana appears at Sanchi through a brief record of a gift. Other inscriptions name monks, nuns and lay donors, sometimes adding a home town, occupation or teacher. Their short texts turn stone railings and monuments into traces of many participants. A sanctuary associated with royal patronage was also sustained by people whose names rarely enter dynastic histories.

Studies of the first-century BCE inscriptions draw particular attention to women’s contributions. Giving allowed donors to participate in a religious community and leave a durable acknowledgement of that participation. The records do not provide complete household budgets or explain every donor’s motives. Their strength is more concrete: they preserve named acts of support. Read them beside the monuments and the scale of the work changes, from the ambition of a ruler to the accumulated gifts of a wider community.
summary.zh:
来自Madhuvana的女性施主Dhamarakhitā，以一则简短的捐献记录出现在桑奇。其他铭文记有僧人、比丘尼与在家施主，有时还注明家乡、职业或师承。石栏和建筑上的短句，因此保存了许多参与者的痕迹。一处与王室赞助相连的圣地，也由那些很少进入王朝史的人共同支持。

研究公元前一世纪铭文的学者尤其注意到女性的贡献。捐献让施主参与宗教社群，并留下持久的记载。这些文字没有完整的家庭收支，也未解释每位施主的动机；它们能够具体证明的，是一次次有名可考的支持行为。把铭文与建筑并读，工程的历史便从君主的事业扩展到众多成员逐步积累的赠予。

dateNote.en: 100–1 BCE is an approximate display interval for the first-century BCE donation records discussed in the inspected study. It is not the construction span of the entire Sanchi complex.
dateNote.zh: 前100—前1年是所读研究讨论的公元前一世纪捐献铭文的约略展示范围，并非整个桑奇遗址群的建设时段。

sources.title: The wheel-turning king and the lucky lottery: perspectives new and old on wealth and merriment within Buddhism
sources.publisher: Saskia Abrahms-Kavunenko and Matthew D. Milligan, Journal of Contemporary Religion 36.2 (2021), pp. 274–275; Max Planck repository
sources.evidenceNote: Actual downloaded PDF pp. 274–275 discusses Sanchi’s donor community, first-century BCE records and inscription 281 naming Dhamarakhitā of Madhuvana. No pilgrimage itinerary is inferred for an individual donor.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 实际下载PDF第274—275页讨论桑奇施主群体、公元前一世纪铭文，以及记Madhuvana女性Dhamarakhitā的281号铭文。不据此推定个人朝圣路线。

sources.title: Some notes on the role of women in Early Buddhism, section 3.2
sources.publisher: Claudia Torlino, Journal of Asian Civilizations 45.2 (2022), pp. 166–167; Ca’ Foscari University repository
sources.evidenceNote: Inspected PDF section 3.2 describes female and nun donors and discusses their economic agency. The story does not generalize this local pattern to all Buddhist societies.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 核查PDF第3.2节对女性与比丘尼施主及其经济能动性的讨论；不将地方材料概括为全部佛教社会的规律。

sources.title: Buddhist Monuments at Sanchi
sources.evidenceNote: Describes the monument complex, its building phases, railings and gateways; used to separate the selected inscriptions from the site’s much longer chronology.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 介绍遗址群、建设阶段、栏楯与塔门，用于区分所选铭文与遗址更长的历史。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis from inspected institutional, primary-text and scholarly passages; each source states which claims it supports.

reviewLimit.en: A recorded gift establishes participation, not a donor’s total wealth or freedom in every part of life. Readings of damaged personal names can vary; only the inspected, consistently transcribed example is named here.
reviewLimit.zh: 一次捐献记录证明参与，并不能确定施主全部财富或生活各方面的自由。残损姓名的释读可能不同；这里只列所核查资料中一致转写的例子。

title.en: Before the cargo: painting cotton on the Coromandel Coast
title.zh: 装船之前：科罗曼德尔海岸的彩绘棉布

labelI18n.zh: 科罗曼德尔海岸，代表性纺织产区

summary.en:
A length of cotton made on India’s Coromandel Coast carries a repeating floral pattern that looks ready for mechanical printing. Much of it was actually painted freehand. The Metropolitan Museum dates the textile to the first quarter of the eighteenth century and identifies a sequence of painted, mordant-dyed and resist-dyed work. Its surface records trained hands as well as knowledge of how cloth, dye and fixing agents interact.

European merchants bought such fabrics for furnishing and dress, joining older Indian Ocean markets for Indian cotton. Trade depended on production communities and supply chains along the coast, not only on ships and company offices. This particular cloth was probably imported by the English East India Company, although its maker and exact workshop remain unknown. Following the pattern back from a European interior restores artisans to a story often told through merchants’ voyages.
summary.zh:
印度科罗曼德尔海岸制作的一幅棉布，重复的花卉纹样看起来像机械印花，实际却有大量徒手绘制的部分。大都会艺术博物馆将其断为十八世纪前四分之一，并注明彩绘、媒染与防染工艺。布面保存的不仅是熟练手法，也包括对纤维、染料与固色材料相互作用的知识。

欧洲商人购买这类布料用于陈设和服装，加入印度棉布早已存在的印度洋市场。贸易依靠沿海生产社群及供应网络，也依靠船只和公司商馆。馆方认为这件布料很可能由英国东印度公司进口，但具体制作者和工坊尚不清楚。沿着花纹从欧洲室内陈设回望海岸，就能把工匠重新带入常由商人航程主导的故事。

dateNote.en: 1700–1725 represents the museum’s first-quarter eighteenth-century attribution. It is an approximate object date, not the beginning or end of Coromandel textile production.
dateNote.zh: 1700—1725年代表馆方“十八世纪前四分之一”的断代，是器物的约略年代，不是科罗曼德尔纺织业的起止年。

sources.title: Textile, 2005.166
sources.evidenceNote: Identifies Coromandel manufacture in the first quarter of the eighteenth century, mostly freehand decoration, painted and resist/mordant-dyed cotton, and probable East India Company import for European furnishing.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 注明科罗曼德尔产地、十八世纪前四分之一年代、大量徒手纹样、彩绘及防染媒染棉布，并将东印度公司进口用于欧洲陈设列为可能判断。

sources.title: The Global Craze for Cotton and Colour
sources.evidenceNote: The painting/printing and global-demand sections explain artisans’ color chemistry, production regions and older Indian Ocean markets followed by European company trade.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 彩绘印染与全球需求章节说明工匠的色彩化学知识、产区、较早的印度洋市场及其后的欧洲公司贸易。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis from inspected institutional, primary-text and scholarly passages; each source states which claims it supports.

reviewLimit.en: The coast marker represents a production region. The cloth’s precise workshop, maker and shipping itinerary are unrecorded in the inspected catalogue.
reviewLimit.zh: 海岸标记代表产区；所读目录未记此布的具体工坊、制作者或运输行程。

title.en: Old cloth, new stories: kantha in Bengal
title.zh: 旧布上的新故事：孟加拉坎塔刺绣

location.label: Bengal, representative point in present-day Bangladesh

labelI18n.en: Bengal, representative point in present-day Bangladesh
labelI18n.zh: 孟加拉地区，以今孟加拉国境内一点代表

summary.en:
Layers of worn clothing became a new surface for storytelling. In Bengal, women stitched kantha for uses that included covers, wrappers and bedding, often reusing thread as well as cloth. Fine running stitches could ripple across the ground, while flowers, household objects, people and religious imagery filled the composition. The familiar material of family life became something newly made.

Museum collections preserve examples from about 1870 to 1930, many passed down as heirlooms. Their present labels must cross a changed political map: historic Bengal includes places now in Bangladesh and India. A maker’s name or village is not always recoverable, and designs cannot simply be read as a diary. Yet their choices of stitches, images and arrangement make domestic creativity visible. These textiles connect women’s work, reuse and the movement of objects from households into collections.
summary.zh:
穿旧的衣物叠成新的布面，也成为讲述故事的地方。在孟加拉，女性缝制坎塔，用作被盖、包覆布和寝具；布料与绣线都可能来自旧物。细密平针在底面形成起伏，花草、家用品、人物及宗教图像则组成画面。家庭生活中熟悉的材料，由此变成新的创造。

博物馆保存了约1870—1930年的许多实例，有些曾作为传家物代代保留。今天为它们标注产地，需要跨越变化的政治地图：历史上的孟加拉地区包括今孟加拉国和印度的部分地区。制作者的姓名和村落未必能够追回，纹样也不能直接当作日记；但针法、图像与布局中的选择，使家中的创造性劳动可见，并联系起女性工作、旧物再用及器物从家庭进入收藏的过程。

dateNote.en: 1870–1930 follows the Philadelphia Museum’s approximate range for the historical nakshi kanthas discussed here. Other kantha forms have different chronologies, and the practice continues.
dateNote.zh: 1870—1930年采用费城艺术博物馆对本条所述历史绣花坎塔的约略范围。其他坎塔形制有不同年代，这一实践也在延续。

sources.title: Kantha: a South Asian quilting tradition
sources.evidenceNote: Describes women’s household making, layered old cloth, reused threads, varied uses and imagery; identifies early twentieth-century examples from Bengal/Bangladesh.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 说明女性在家中制作、旧布分层、旧线再用、用途与图像，并介绍孟加拉地区或孟加拉国的二十世纪初实例。

sources.title: A Century of Kanthas: Women’s Quilts in Bengal, 1870s–1970s
sources.evidenceNote: The historical nakshi section gives about 1870–1930, running stitches, household and devotional imagery, and heirloom transmission; distinguishes later galicha forms. Images are restricted press material and are not reused.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 历史绣花坎塔部分给出约1870—1930年，介绍平针、家庭与信仰图像及传家过程，并与后期galicha形制区分。图片属受限新闻材料，本条未复制。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis from inspected institutional, primary-text and scholarly passages; each source states which claims it supports.

reviewLimit.en: A representative regional point avoids assigning an unrecorded village. Household textiles are evidence of making and use; individual motives require additional documentation.
reviewLimit.zh: 使用代表性地区点，避免给未记载的产地指定村落。家用织物可证明制作与用途；个人动机仍需其他资料。

title.en: From a Vietnamese kiln to a ship’s hold

location.label: Waters near the Cham Islands, representative Hội An wreck area

labelI18n.en: Waters near the Cham Islands, representative Hội An wreck area
labelI18n.zh: 占婆岛附近海域，会安沉船的代表性区域

summary.en:
A bird moves among clouds on a blue-and-white dish recovered from the Hội An shipwreck. The Metropolitan Museum attributes it to early-sixteenth-century Vietnam, probably Hải Dương. Another object from the cargo, a small wine cup in the Smithsonian, is dated to the fifteenth century and associated with Chu Đậu. Together they bring a ceramic-producing region into a maritime story.

Kilns in the Red River delta supplied pots that could travel by river toward coastal shipping. The wreck near the Cham Islands preserved a sample of that export activity, connecting painters, potters, packers and seafarers. Its modern name refers to the discovery area, not a proven itinerary for every vessel or pot. The objects’ dates cluster around the turn of the sixteenth century; they do not establish a single exact sinking year. Look first at the brushwork, then at the journey the material makes possible to investigate.
summary.zh:
一只鸟穿行在青花云纹之间。这件从会安沉船中打捞出的盘子，被大都会艺术博物馆断为十六世纪初越南制品，产地很可能是海阳。史密森学会收藏的同批货物中，一只小酒杯断为十五世纪，并与朱豆窑相联系。两件器物把一个陶瓷产区带入海上交流的历史。

红河三角洲的窑场生产陶器，货物可以沿河运往沿海装船处。占婆岛附近的沉船保存了这种出口活动的一部分，也联系起画工、陶工、装货者与航海者。“会安沉船”这一现代名称指向发现区域，并不能证明船只或每件器物的完整行程。器物年代集中于十五、十六世纪之交，却没有确定唯一的沉没年份。先看笔触，再追问材料让哪些运输和劳动关系可以被研究。

dateNote.en: 1475–1525 is an editorial approximate window for the late-fifteenth- to early-sixteenth-century cargo. It is not an independently dated sinking interval. The illustrated dish is catalogued early sixteenth century.
dateNote.zh: 1475—1525年是为十五世纪末至十六世纪初货物设置的约略展示窗口，并非独立测定的沉船时段。配图盘子的目录年代为十六世纪初。

sources.title: Dish with bird in clouds, 2023.585
sources.evidenceNote: The object record identifies an early-sixteenth-century Vietnamese blue-and-white dish, probably Hải Dương, recovered from the Hội An shipwreck. The image is marked Public Domain; catalogue attribution remains qualified.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 目录注明十六世纪初越南青花盘，很可能产自海阳，出自会安沉船。图像标为公版；产地仍保留可能性。

sources.title: Unseen Art History: Wine Cup from the Hoi An Hoard Shipwreck
sources.publisher: Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art
sources.evidenceNote: Discusses a fifteenth-century Chu Đậu cup, Red River delta production, movement by river toward Vân Đồn, and the wreck’s late-fifteenth-/early-sixteenth-century context. Proposed final destination and cause of sinking are not adopted.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 讨论十五世纪朱豆酒杯、红河三角洲生产、沿河运往云屯的过程及沉船处于十五世纪末至十六世纪初的背景。未采用推测的最终目的地与沉没原因。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis from inspected institutional, primary-text and scholarly passages; each source states which claims it supports.

reviewLimit.en: Probable kiln attribution and approximate object dates remain qualified. The discovery name does not prove a Hội An departure, crew identity or destination.
reviewLimit.zh: 保留窑口归属的可能性与器物约略断代；发现地名称不能证明从会安出发、船员身份或目的地。

title.en: A cargo of bowls: the Belitung shipwreck

location.label: Waters near Belitung, representative wreck region

labelI18n.en: Waters near Belitung, representative wreck region
labelI18n.zh: 勿里洞附近海域，代表性沉船区域

summary.en:
Thousands of bowls made in the Changsha kilns crossed the sea together before their ship sank near Belitung around the ninth century. Fine metalwork and other ceramics traveled in the same cargo. The quantity makes the labor behind exchange visible: making vessels, preparing a shipment and handling goods at sea were connected activities, even when the workers’ names were never recorded.

The hull adds another connection. Its planks were sewn together, a construction tradition associated with the western Indian Ocean. Chinese cargo and this shipbuilding method support a history of maritime exchange across several regions, while the actual departure port and final destination remain unknown. Discovered in 1998, the wreck later became the subject of debate over commercial salvage and museum display. The objects now carry two histories: the voyage that brought them to Indonesian waters, and the decisions that dispersed or preserved them afterward.
summary.zh:
成千上万只长沙窑陶碗随船出海，约在九世纪随船沉入勿里洞附近海域。同船还有精细金属器与其他陶瓷。货物数量让交流背后的劳动浮现出来：制作器皿、备办货物、海上装卸相互衔接，即使参与者的姓名没有留下。

船体提供了另一条联系。船板以缝合方式连接，这种造船传统与西印度洋有关。中国货物与船体技术共同支持跨地区海上交流的历史，但实际出发港和最终目的地仍不明确。沉船于1998年被发现，后来围绕商业打捞和博物馆展览产生争论。如今这些器物承载两段历史：把它们带到今印度尼西亚海域的航行，以及发现后决定其分散或保存的过程。

dateNote.en: About 830 is a conventional display anchor for a ninth-century wreck and associated objects, not a precisely recorded sinking year. Discovery in 1998 is part of the later archaeological history.
dateNote.zh: 约830年是九世纪沉船与相关器物的通常展示锚点，并非有精确记录的沉没年。1998年发现属于后来的考古史。

sources.title: Smithsonian and Singapore Present Shipwreck Treasures
sources.publisher: Smithsonian National Museum of Asian Art, 2010 announcement
sources.evidenceNote: Describes ninth-century cargo, ceramics and metalwork, 1998 discovery, sewn construction and explicitly unknown departure and destination ports. The planned exhibition is not described as having occurred.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 介绍九世纪货物、陶瓷金属器、1998年发现、缝合船体，并明确出发港与目的港不详。不把当时计划中的展览写成已举办。

sources.title: Wrecked? Belitung, Indonesia and the politics of maritime heritage
sources.publisher: Natali Pearson, University of Melbourne, Indonesia at Melbourne
sources.evidenceNote: Identifies Changsha bowls, western Indian Ocean construction connections, objects dated about 830, and the commercial-salvage/display debate. Used as a named scholar’s analysis; no current legal advice or exact total cargo count is repeated.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 说明长沙窑碗、西印度洋船体技术联系、约830年的器物及商业打捞和展示争议。作为署名学者分析采用，不重复当前法律意见或精确货物总数。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis from inspected institutional, primary-text and scholarly passages; each source states which claims it supports.

reviewLimit.en: Construction technique is not proof of every crew member’s ethnicity. Neither a complete route nor a single exact wreck date is reconstructed.
reviewLimit.zh: 船体技术不能证明每名船员的族属；不复原完整路线，也不确定唯一精确沉没年。

title.en: Aceh’s queens: trading power and remembered ancestry
title.zh: 亚齐女王：贸易权力与祖先记忆

location.label: Banda Aceh, representative court and port

labelI18n.en: Banda Aceh, representative court and port
labelI18n.zh: 班达亚齐，代表性王廷与港口

summary.en:
Four women ruled Aceh in succession between 1641 and 1699. The first, Taj al-Alam Safiatuddin, inherited a court whose authority drew on dynastic connections as well as overseas commerce. Historian Su Fang Ng shows how her presentation of ancestry linked her rule to her father Iskandar Muda; legendary descent was a language of legitimacy, not a modern family record.

A Dutch civilian ship’s memorandum from 1689 offers another view, written during Kamalat Syah’s reign. Sher Banu Khan’s introduction places it amid competing English and Dutch trading ambitions and the VOC’s attempts to bypass Aceh through agreements elsewhere on Sumatra. Read together, the sources connect queenship with negotiation, commercial pressure and the stories used to authorize power. They also invite a comparison between what a court said about itself and what visiting traders wanted to know.
summary.zh:
1641—1699年，四位女性相继统治亚齐。首位女王塔吉·阿拉姆·萨菲亚图丁所继承的王廷，权威既来自王朝联系，也来自海外商业。历史学者Su Fang Ng讨论她如何以祖系叙述连接父亲伊斯坎达尔·穆达的统治；传说中的血统，是表达合法性的语言，并非现代意义的家谱事实。

1689年，一艘荷兰民用商船的备忘录留下另一种视角，当时在位者为卡玛拉特·沙。谢尔·巴努·汗的导读将它放在英荷贸易竞争，以及荷兰东印度公司试图通过苏门答腊其他地区的协议绕开亚齐的背景下。两类材料并读，可把女性统治与谈判、商业压力、权力叙事相连，也能比较王廷如何描述自身，以及来访商人希望了解什么。

dateNote.en: 1641–1699 covers the succession of four queens. The trader memorandum is dated 1689 and belongs to Kamalat Syah’s reign, not to the first queen’s.
dateNote.zh: 1641—1699年涵盖四位女王相继统治。商船备忘录作于1689年，属于卡玛拉特·沙在位时期，并非首位女王的时代。

sources.title: Memorandum of the chiefs of the civilian yacht Den Arent about Aceh in 1689: introduction
sources.publisher: Sher Banu A. L. Khan, Arsip Nasional Republik Indonesia, Sejarah Nusantara
sources.evidenceNote: The archival introduction identifies the four queens and their reigns, the 1689 memorandum’s civilian authors, Dutch withdrawal and English/Dutch commercial rivalry.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 档案导读注明四位女王及在位年、1689年备忘录的民用船作者、荷方退缩与英荷商业竞争。

sources.title: Genealogical Memory: Constructing Female Rule in Seventeenth-Century Aceh
sources.publisher: Su Fang Ng, in Gendered Temporalities in the Early Modern World, Amsterdam University Press (2018); Cambridge Core
sources.evidenceNote: The publicly accessible abstract and opening passage analyze Taj al-Alam’s adaptation of paternal genealogy and legendary ancestry. Full chapter access is not claimed.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 公开摘要与开头文字分析塔吉·阿拉姆对父系祖系和传说祖先的运用；未声称读取完整章节。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis from inspected institutional, primary-text and scholarly passages; each source states which claims it supports.

reviewLimit.en: Royal genealogy is analyzed as political representation. Female succession does not by itself establish equality for every woman in Acehnese society.
reviewLimit.zh: 王室祖系作为政治表达分析；女性相继登位本身，不能证明亚齐社会所有女性享有平等地位。

title.en: Behind the signature: batik workshops in Pekalongan
title.zh: 署名之后：北加浪岸的蜡染工坊

labelI18n.zh: 北加浪岸，代表性工坊城市

summary.en:
A sarong made around 1910 carries Eliza van Zuylen’s signature. Her Pekalongan workshop used imported cotton and produced hand-drawn batik: workers applied wax with a canting, dyed the cloth, removed the wax and repeated the process for additional colors. Women commonly performed the waxing. A business name on the finished cloth therefore represented the coordinated work of several hands.

The town’s production also crossed community boundaries. LACMA’s study of another cloth describes Indo-European entrepreneurs sending certain patterns to Indo-Arab workshops around 1890. Its mixture of natural and synthetic dyes records changes in materials as well as taste. These examples connect colonial commerce with local expertise and specialized subcontracting. Comparing signed and anonymous cloths makes it possible to ask who designed, who financed, who worked and whose name finally remained attached to the object.
summary.zh:
一条约1910年制作的纱笼，带有伊丽莎·范·宰伦的署名。她在北加浪岸的工坊使用进口棉布，制作手绘蜡染：工人用蜡绘笔（canting）布蜡，再染色、去蜡，并为增加颜色重复工序。布蜡工作常由女性承担。成品上的商号或经营者姓名，因此代表着多双手的协作。

城中的生产也跨越社群界限。洛杉矶郡艺术博物馆对另一件织物的研究指出，约1890年，一些印欧裔经营者会把特定纹样交由印阿裔工坊制作。天然染料与合成染料并用，则记录了材料和审美的变化。这些实例把殖民商业、地方技术和专业分包相连。比较有署名与无署名的布料，可以继续追问谁设计、谁出资、谁劳动，以及最后留下了谁的名字。

dateNote.en: 1890–1910 links the documented workshop/subcontracting context around 1890 with two museum cloths dated about 1910. It is a selected episode, not the full lifespan of Pekalongan batik.
dateNote.zh: 1890—1910年联系约1890年的工坊及分包背景，与两件断为约1910年的馆藏织物。这里只选取一个阶段，并非北加浪岸蜡染的全部历史。

sources.title: Cotton sarong from North Java, 85/1074
sources.publisher: Powerhouse Museum; Hweifen Cheah’s curatorial note
sources.evidenceNote: Identifies the circa-1910 Eliza van Zuylen workshop sarong, signature, imported cotton, wax-resist process and women’s waxing work. The source’s restricted text/image licences do not become atlas asset licences.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 注明约1910年范·宰伦工坊纱笼、署名、进口棉布、防染工序与女性布蜡劳动。原网页文字和图像的受限许可，不转作图集资产许可。

sources.title: Woman’s Hip Wrapper, M.91.184.345
sources.publisher: Los Angeles County Museum of Art, curatorial notes after Rens Heringa and Harmen C. Veldhuisen
sources.evidenceNote: Dates the Pekalongan cloth to about 1910; identifies natural and synthetic dyes and describes Indo-European outsourcing of selected patterns to Indo-Arab workshops around 1890.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 将北加浪岸织物断为约1910年，注明天然及合成染料，并讨论约1890年印欧裔经营者将部分纹样交由印阿裔工坊制作。

expansion.sourceReview: Original bilingual synthesis from inspected institutional, primary-text and scholarly passages; each source states which claims it supports.

reviewLimit.en: A workshop signature does not identify every worker. The two catalogued cloths illustrate selected production relationships, not all batik practice in Java.
reviewLimit.zh: 工坊署名不等于所有工人姓名；两件馆藏织物说明部分生产关系，并非爪哇所有蜡染实践。
